content.short: Drasil is a modular Cardano application framework for no-code tokens, NFTs, staking, and utilities for projects.
content.description: Drasil is a modular blockchain application framework that helps projects and businesses create, manage, and integrate Cardano applications. The platform provides code-free access to common workflows such as token rewards, token distribution, NFT marketplaces, shops, minting, staking, vesting, and other blockchain utilities. By packaging these functions into reusable modules, Drasil lowers development overhead for teams that need practical Cardano infrastructure. It is best understood as an application-building layer for ecosystem projects.
content.meta: Drasil provides modular no-code framework tools for Cardano tokens, NFTs, staking, and app utilities. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
